nodes.text: What is 'the stuff we talked about'? No earlier conversation or notes are available in this session, so its points can't be recovered. Paste or point to them.
Which calibration? E.g. forecasting/probability judgments, ML model confidence, instrument/measurement calibration, or calibrating trust and judgment in a team.
What should the piece argue? One sentence the reader should come away believing, or a takeaway the piece should leave them with.
Who reads the newsletter, and what do they already know about the topic?
Any evidence, examples or sources to build on (data, an incident, a study, a personal anecdote)? Each claim will get an evidence slot, and slots stay empty until you name something to fill them.
Target length and format: a short note, a standard issue, or a long-form essay?
